description: This is a C# source file defining a static utility class 'Utils' in the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It contains various helper methods for string representations of collections, parsing URIs, exception handling, batching enumerables, and stack trace retrieval.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for collection string representation, URI parsing, exception handling, batching, and stack trace retrieval within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: EnumerableToString
methods.description: Converts an IEnumerable collection to a human-readable string, optionally formatting elements with a custom toString function, separator, and brackets.

methods.name: DictionaryToString
methods.description: Converts a collection of key-value pairs into a formatted string representation, with optional custom string conversion for values.

methods.name: TimeSpanToString
methods.description: Converts a TimeSpan object into a human-readable string with hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds.

methods.name: TicksToMilliSeconds
methods.description: Converts a number of ticks into milliseconds.

methods.name: AverageTicksToMilliSeconds
methods.description: Converts a float representing ticks to milliseconds.

methods.name: ToIPEndPoint
methods.description: Parses a Uri with scheme 'gwy.tcp' into an IPEndPoint.

methods.name: ToGatewayAddress
methods.description: Parses a Uri with scheme 'gwy.tcp' into a SiloAddress object, excluding generation identifier.

methods.name: ToGatewayUri (IPEndPoint)
methods.description: Formats an IPEndPoint as a gateway URI.

methods.name: ToGatewayUri (SiloAddress)
methods.description: Formats a SiloAddress as a gateway URI.

methods.name: SafeExecute
methods.description: Executes an action safely, catching and ignoring exceptions.

methods.name: SafeExecute (with logger)
methods.description: Executes an action safely, logs and ignores exceptions if a logger is provided.

methods.name: SafeExecuteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a task, catching and ignoring exceptions.

methods.name: GetStackTrace
methods.description: Retrieves the current stack trace as a string, with optional frame skipping.
